english.name: Galaxy Saviors
english.description: Complete the first screen eager to continue playing.

schinese.name: 银河救星
schinese.description: 完成第一关，迫不及待地继续游玩。

english.name: Lab Intern
english.description: Buy an upgrade in the upgrades screen, Tech Lab.

schinese.name: 实验室实习生
schinese.description: 在科技实验室的升级界面购买一项升级。

english.name: Breath of the Wild
english.description: Find the hidden Korok in "Call to Action".

schinese.name: 旷野之息
schinese.description: 在“行动召唤”中找到隐藏的克洛格。

english.name: The Guardian
english.description: Don't lose any confused guardian in "Echoes of Madness".

schinese.name: 守护者
schinese.description: 在“疯狂回声”中不损失任何迷茫的守护者。

english.name: Hoth Maneuver
english.description: Destroy the stolen Mechas on the "Great Heist" mission in under 3 minutes.

schinese.name: 霍斯战术
schinese.description: 在“大劫案”任务中，于 3 分钟内摧毁被盗的机甲。

english.name: Ashes to Ashes
english.description: Kill 1 Phoenix in mission "The Great Heist".

schinese.name: 尘归尘
schinese.description: 在“大劫案”任务中击杀 1 只凤凰。

english.name: Mr. Fence
english.description: Beat the mission "Prison Break" without losing a single fence.

schinese.name: 围栏先生
schinese.description: 在不损失任何围栏的情况下完成“越狱”任务。

english.name: Towering
english.description: Beat "High Hold" by building 1 type of Defensive tower.

schinese.name: 高塔耸立
schinese.description: 只建造 1 种防御塔，完成“高地要塞”。

english.name: The Transporter
english.description: Escort Sophos to safety without capturing any Crystal Henge.

schinese.name: 护送者
schinese.description: 不占领任何水晶巨石阵，将索福斯护送至安全地点。

english.name: Suicide Squad
english.description: Free the Emissary on "Sword of Damocles" mission without building a single Refinery.

schinese.name: 自杀小队
schinese.description: 不建造任何精炼厂，在“达摩克利斯之剑”任务中解救使者。

english.name: From the Deep
english.description: Find and interact with the swampy creature in mission "Sword of Damocles"

schinese.name: 来自深渊
schinese.description: 在“达摩克利斯之剑”任务中找到沼泽生物，并与其互动。

english.name: Do you want to kill a snowman?
english.description: Destroy 5 snowmen in mission "Battle for Borealis".

schinese.name: 你想杀个雪人吗？
schinese.description: 在“北境之战”任务中摧毁 5 个雪人。

english.name: Monster Hunter
english.description: Kill a Void Prowler in less than 10 minutes.

schinese.name: 怪物猎人
schinese.description: 在 10 分钟内击杀一只虚空潜行者。

english.name: The Last of Them
english.description: Have all Maluhia natives reach safety without any of them dying in the mission "Independence Day".

schinese.name: 最后的幸存者
schinese.description: 在“独立日”任务中，让所有马鲁希亚原住民安全抵达，且无人死亡。

english.name: Handle with Care
english.description: Beat "Paradigm Shift" without any ancient cocoon taking damage.

schinese.name: 小心轻放
schinese.description: 在所有远古虫茧均未受伤的情况下完成“范式转移”。

english.name: Robot in disguise
english.description: Find the infiltrating robot in mission "Unthinkable".

schinese.name: 伪装机器人
schinese.description: 在“不可思议”任务中找到潜入的机器人。

english.name: The Boy in the Iceberg
english.description: Find the Air Nomad and release him from his ice prison in the mission "Plant Closure".

schinese.name: 冰山中的男孩
schinese.description: 在“工厂关闭”任务中找到气和族人，并将他从冰牢中释放。

english.name: Outer Wilds
english.description: Clear at least 3 missions in Frozen terrain.

schinese.name: 星际拓荒
schinese.description: 在冰冻地形中完成至少 3 个任务。

english.name: Monopoly
english.description: Beat the mission "Killing Grounds" with all refineries captured.

schinese.name: 大富翁
schinese.description: 占领所有精炼厂，完成“杀戮之地”任务。

english.name: C:Human
english.description: Find ans interact with the remains of the robot couple in the mission "Crimson and Present Danger".

schinese.name: C：人类
schinese.description: 在“猩红危机”任务中找到机器人情侣的残骸，并与其互动。

english.name: Desert Express
english.description: Defeat the Crimson Vulture's Leader.

schinese.name: 沙漠快车
schinese.description: 击败猩红秃鹫的首领。

english.name: Hold the Door
english.description: Defeat Aart Ruin before he destroys the next to last barrier.

schinese.name: 守住大门
schinese.description: 在阿特·鲁因摧毁倒数第二道屏障前将其击败。

english.name: Altar of the Paragon
english.description: Uncover and interact with the statue of the Empyrean hero, Paragon, in the mission "Epiphany".

schinese.name: 典范祭坛
schinese.description: 在“顿悟”任务中找到天界英雄“典范”的雕像，并与其互动。

english.name: Kill the Messenger
english.description: Defeat the Dark Empyrean's Leader.

schinese.name: 斩杀信使
schinese.description: 击败黑暗天界的首领。

english.name: Pitch Black
english.description: Close all 3 Sovereign's eyes at the same time in "The Thing at the Doorstep".

schinese.name: 漆黑一片
schinese.description: 在“门前之物”中同时关闭君主的全部 3 只眼睛。

english.name: 12 Monkeys
english.description: Find and recruit all twelve Iron monkeys scattered across the galaxy.

schinese.name: 十二猴子
schinese.description: 找到并招募散落在银河各处的全部十二只钢铁猴。

english.name: ENDGAME
english.description: Defeat the Raad Leader.

schinese.name: 终局
schinese.description: 击败拉德首领。

english.name: Medal of Valor
english.description: Beat the game in Veteran.

schinese.name: 英勇勋章
schinese.description: 以老兵难度通关游戏。

english.name: Big Spender
english.description: Purchase at least 5000 credits worth of Items at the Arsenal.

schinese.name: 挥金如土
schinese.description: 在军械库购买总价值至少 5000 信用点的道具。

english.name: Botanist
english.description: Find all the different hidden plant creatures scattered across the galaxy.

schinese.name: 植物学家
schinese.description: 找到散落在银河各处的所有不同种类的隐藏植物生物。

english.name: Superheroes
english.description: Get 2 Heroes to Max level.

schinese.name: 超级英雄
schinese.description: 让 2 名英雄达到满级。

english.name: Checklist
english.description: Beat at least one of each Spec Op type missions.

schinese.name: 清单核对
schinese.description: 每种类型的特别行动任务都至少完成一次。

english.name: Bodyguard
english.description: Complete an Escort type Special Operation without the merchansts taking any damage.

schinese.name: 保镖
schinese.description: 完成一次护送类特别行动，且商人未受到任何伤害。

english.name: Help not needed
english.description: Complete a Rescue type Special Operation without recruiting a squad.

schinese.name: 无需援助
schinese.description: 不招募任何小队，完成一次救援类特别行动。
